phase: predeclared before image viewing, caption/OCR payload reads, and new rankings

selection.video_order: sorted canonical L04_V[0-9]{3} directory names under dataset/data/L04 only
selection.image_order: canonical numeric .jpg stems sorted numerically, distinct identities
selection.target_indices_zero_based: floor((image_count-1)/3), floor(2*(image_count-1)/3); require both in [2,image_count-3] and distinct
selection.assigned_kinds: literal, scene, mixed repeated in selected-video then selected-image order, before viewing
selection.fallback: If reliable exact on-screen text cannot be read for a literal/mixed assignment, use scene on the SAME image and record reason; no substitution
selection.dev_reference: benchmarks/l04_ocr_exploratory_20261111.json; eight frozen single-positive queries, never edited; no tuning

judgments.inspection: Read each actual target plus the image-list positions -2,-1,+1,+2 through the image read tool (120 total intended reads). No caption/OCR text or retrieval ranks used for query authoring or relevance judgments.
judgments.relevance: Binary, whole natural-language query must be visibly supported. For literal/mixed, exact quoted on-screen strings must be readable. Include every inspected relevant neighbor; no automatic temporal/video relevance. Explicit visible differences justify negatives.
judgments.record: Each judgment includes target identity, judged identity, source_image, local image_sha256, label 0/1, rationale. Target must be positive. Uninspected images UNJUDGED, not negatives; qrels incomplete.
judgments.language: Natural English scene descriptions. Preserve exact readable Vietnamese/English strings for literal/mixed. Mark English or English+Vietnamese per query. Visual transcription by this assistant, no independent human verification; small compressed broadcast text may be ambiguous. Source image grounding does not prove upstream OCR byte provenance.
judgments.freeze: Write selected identities, queries, image hashes and judgments into new packet before loading any caption/OCR payload or ranking. Never change packet or weights after results. Record actual packet/protocol/config SHA256 in final manifests.

scoring.bm25: rank_bm25.BM25Okapi; all 7471 L04 caption candidates, stable ties (video_id,keyframe_n); positive finite scores only; safe no-hit result for empty corpus/vocabulary
scoring.concatenation: caption + newline + valid nonblank public OCR; same as legacy treatment

rrf.ranks: one-based over ALL positive finite scores, no topN truncation

scoring.ocr_missing_empty_error: Retain candidates, no OCR contribution; recognized technical envelopes count-only. Malformed/unknown/duplicate fail closed.
scoring.integrity: Validate packet identities, image paths/SHA, mapping frame_idx (never n-1), duplicate qrels, nonempty positives and all 7471 candidates/30 videos. Verify caption-image hashes where available. Public seven-field OCR arrays lack image SHA: OCR image-byte provenance UNVERIFIED.
scoring.metrics: Known-judged-positive Hit@1/5/10 and MRR@10 from earliest positive rank; separately exact chosen target rank/metrics. Split new24 test vs old8 dev-reference, kind and language, all four arms. RRF vs caption win/tie/loss separately for earliest positive and target. Null ranks treated as infinity. Raw scores not calibrated across arms.
scoring.report: Top10 identities, scores, caption/OCR evidence, RRF component ranks; candidate/qrels coverage; source/dependency/input/query/protocol/config hashes and full settings. Discuss concentrated gains, scene regressions, language confounding, incomplete judgments. No production recommendation without metrics; not full multimodal/system accuracy.

execution: Offline in-memory CPU BM25 only. No network/install/inference/LLM API/Milvus/index rebuild/production edits. Only dataset/{data,caption_generator,mapping,ocr}/L04; never enumerate/read excluded group roots. Unique output directory, final reports frozen.
